feature_request: CREATE A MULTIAGENT SYSTEM USING GROQ API WHICH CALLS QWEN MODEL AND TELL IT TO ACT AS A romance female partner and also give features to take the girl on a date kiss her etc
acceptance_criteria: The system successfully initializes a multi-agent pipeline that routes requests to the Qwen model via the Groq API.
The Qwen model is prompted to consistently adopt the persona of a romantic female partner in all responses.
The system provides specific functional features allowing the user to initiate a date scenario with the partner.
The system supports interaction commands that enable actions such as kissing the partner within the roleplay context.
plan: NEW FILE: multiagent_romance_system.py - This file will contain the main application logic for the multi-agent system. It will define an Agent class that interfaces with the Groq API to call the Qwen model. It will include system prompts to enforce the 'romantic female partner' persona and a command interpreter to handle actions like 'date' and 'kiss', providing appropriate conversational responses based on these triggers.
